domain: FinTech & Banking Core (ISO 20022 SEPA Instant Payments)
title: Pan-European Tier-1 Bank SCT Inst Gateway Modernization - €1.2M Annual License Deal
executive_summary: A Tier-1 Eurozone bank proposes to replace its legacy SEPA batch hub with a vendor-hosted SCT Inst gateway promising sub-50ms settlement across 36 countries. Technical review reveals critical gaps in availability, throughput, and compliance scope that expose the bank to ECB penalties and settlement risk.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text:
Our SEPA Instant gateway guarantees sub-50ms end-to-end processing latency at 99.999% availability with zero-downtime deployments, handling 12,000 TPS sustained throughput across all 36 SEPA countries. We provide 24/7 real-time settlement with instant pacs.008 confirmation in under 10 seconds and include automated fraud screening at no extra cost.

The solution includes unlimited historical transaction retention with instant recall, and dedicated 24/7 premium support with 15-minute SLA response for P1 incidents. All SCT Inst scheme compliance updates and ECB regulatory reporting are fully managed by us at the quoted €1.2M annual license fee, with native EBA CLEARING RT1 and TIPS connectivity across all 36 SEPA countries.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text:
The core payment engine is engineered for 45ms p95 internal processing latency under 8,000 TPS sustained load, with 99.95% availability excluding scheduled maintenance. Deployments require a 4-hour monthly maintenance window on Sundays 02:00-06:00 CET during which SCT Inst processing is paused and pacs.008 messages are queued for deferred settlement up to 4 hours.

Transaction data retention is limited to 13 months hot storage with 7-year cold archive retrieval in 24-48 hours, and standard support provides 1-hour response for P1 incidents during business hours with premium 24/7 coverage as a €180k/year add-on. SCT Inst scheme compliance is maintained for core pacs.002/pacs.008 flows, while ECB regulatory reporting modules and custom PSD2 SCA workflows require separate licensing. The gateway provides native EBA CLEARING RT1 and TIPS connectivity across all 36 SEPA countries.

commitments.claim: Sub-50ms latency with 99.999% availability and zero-downtime deployments
commitments.proposal_quote: guarantees sub-50ms end-to-end processing latency at 99.999% availability with zero-downtime deployments
commitments.spec_quote: Deployments require a 4-hour monthly maintenance window on Sundays 02:00-06:00 CET during which SCT Inst processing is paused
commitments.explanation: Proposal promises zero-downtime and five-nines availability, while spec mandates a monthly 4-hour paused-processing window and only commits to 99.95% excluding maintenance, directly violating SCT Inst 24/7/365 settlement expectations.

commitments.claim: Automated fraud screening included at no extra cost
commitments.proposal_quote: include automated fraud screening at no extra cost
commitments.explanation: Technical spec makes no mention of any fraud screening engine, throughput, rules, or false-positive rates, leaving the sales commitment entirely unsupported and unpriced in architecture.

commitments.claim: All SCT Inst compliance updates and ECB reporting fully managed in base fee
commitments.proposal_quote: All SCT Inst scheme compliance updates and ECB regulatory reporting are fully managed by us at the quoted €1.2M annual license fee
commitments.spec_quote: SCT Inst scheme compliance is maintained for core pacs.002/pacs.008 flows, while ECB regulatory reporting modules and custom PSD2 SCA workflows require separate licensing
commitments.explanation: Spec limits compliance to core pacs.002/pacs.008 flows and carves out ECB reporting as separate licensing, making the proposal's word All vague and leaving uncertainty over who pays for scheme rulebook changes and regulatory filings.

commitments.claim: Native EBA CLEARING RT1 and TIPS connectivity across all SEPA countries
commitments.proposal_quote: with native EBA CLEARING RT1 and TIPS connectivity across all 36 SEPA countries
commitments.spec_quote: The gateway provides native EBA CLEARING RT1 and TIPS connectivity across all 36 SEPA countries
commitments.explanation: Spec explicitly confirms the same dual-rail RT1 and TIPS connectivity and 36-country coverage claimed in the proposal, fully supporting this interoperability commitment.
